sources.name: Billboard and Vibe 50 Greatest Rappers of All Time (editorial boards)
sources.method: Editorial ranking 1-50 (full list read from page); Wikipedia summary at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_and_Vibe%27s_50_Greatest_Rappers_of_All_Time

sources.name: NME.com readers' vote: Greatest Rappers Ever (top 30)
sources.method: Reader vote, 1-30 (UK-leaning; voter count not stated). Excluded for Travis Scott (not yet active).

sources.name: Celebrity Family Feud best-rapper survey (100 people surveyed), HipHopDX report
sources.method: Public survey, top 8 answers only: Snoop, 2Pac, Eminem, Dr. Dre, LL Cool J, Biggie, 50 Cent, Jay-Z.

sources.name: YouGov Ratings: popularity of rap & hip-hop music artists (US)
sources.method: Share with a positive opinion; only top 20 visible (pool includes groups and non-rappers). It measures likability, not greatness.

sources.name: Commercial composite (counted as ONE source): rapper-only order within RIAA US certified units (Wikipedia), Wikipedia worldwide certified units, and Billboard Greatest of All Time Billboard 200 Artists
sources.method: Mean of each rapper's position among rappers in the three lists (missing = rappers listed + 5). Other URLs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_best-selling_music_artists ; https://www.billboard.com/charts/greatest-of-all-time-artists/

changes_vs_current: Out: J. Cole, Lauryn Hill, Dr. Dre, Method Man, Busta Rhymes, DMX, Travis Scott (Dre ranks 28th; Cole 26th, Lauryn 25th, just outside). In: Ice Cube/LL/50 Cent moved up, plus Big Pun, Ghostface, Big Daddy Kane, Black Thought, Q-Tip, Mos Def from the Billboard and NME lists.
confidence: low: only ONE rigorous rap-specific panel (Billboard/Vibe 2023) exists in what I could fetch. The other inputs are weak (NME 2013 UK reader vote, a 100-person Family Feud survey with top 8 only, YouGov likability top 20, sales). Ranker was skipped as instructed; Rolling Stone and Complex have no all-time rapper list I could read; Forbes list returned 403. Averages are tightly bunched (positions 10-24 span only 13.8-19.0), so order there is noisy and positions 14, 16, 18-19, 22-24 (Big Pun, Ghostface, Kane, Black Thought, Q-Tip, KRS-One, Mos Def) come mostly from the NME vote. Billboard/Vibe alone would give: Jay-Z, Kendrick, Nas, Tupac, Eminem, Biggie, Lil Wayne, Drake, Snoop, Nicki, Kanye, Andre 3000. Consider using Billboard/Vibe as the backbone and treating this blend with caution.
